decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter was launched only a year ago and so far is only mentioned on the website, which suggests weaker support, but its value remains uncertain and keeping a sliced line extension on existing equipment costs little, so the option stays open for now.

The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own page, so the firm is actively supporting it, and it targets the growing organic and poultry snacking segments with uncertainty still unresolved, so keeping this cheap option is the better choice.
The premium sharing salami snack is prominently presented and fits the trend toward premium snacking, and it is too early for the results to show that its value will not be realized, so it is kept.
